_about: Shown on the Validation page. Every number is copied from a result file in verification/ (named in 'file'); update together.

tests.id_txt: GPU vs CPU: hasil mesin kartu grafis sama dengan mesin acuan di prosesor pada medan asli (kotak Manggarai, 2 jam hujan 1 Jan 2020).
tests.en_txt: GPU vs CPU: the graphics-card engine gives the same result as the processor reference on real terrain (Manggarai box, first 2 h of the 1 Jan 2020 storm).

tests.id_txt: Neraca air: hujan + air hulu = resapan + keluar + ke laut + tersimpan. Diuji otomatis dan dilaporkan di setiap simulasi.
tests.en_txt: Water balance: rain + upstream inflow = infiltration + outflow + sea + storage. Tested automatically and reported with every run.
metrics: Mass error, whole region 30 h (90 m)

tests.id_txt: Uji analitik gelombang banjir di dataran datar (Hunter dkk. 2005): skema numerik yang sama dengan mesin v2.
tests.en_txt: Analytical flood-wave test on a flat plane (Hunter et al. 2005): same numerical scheme as engine v2.

tests.id_txt: Dibanding model terbitan SFINCS 2.4.0 (Deltares) pada medan, hujan dan kekasaran yang sama (mesin v1, skema sama; v2 akan diuji ulang).
tests.en_txt: Against the published SFINCS 2.4.0 model (Deltares) on the same terrain, rain and roughness (engine v1, same scheme; v2 re-run pending).

tests.id_txt: Ukuran sel: sejak November 2026 (ADR 0018) sel 10, 5, 2 dan 1 m memakai aliran yang sama dengan 30 m dan hanya menggambar permukaan airnya lebih halus (sejak 13 Nov 2026 tanpa potongan bentuk bangunan). Kotak 2,2 km di Kampung Melayu (Ciliwung), hujan 150 mm/6 jam: 30, 10, 5 dan 2 m semuanya 0,4 km², terdalam 0,80 m, 2.186 bangunan, 9.328 penduduk. Sebelumnya aliran dihitung ulang di sel kecil dan memberi hasil di tempat lain (kecocokan tempat dengan 30 m hanya 6–17 %, terdalam 4,5 m); cara itu sudah dihapus dari aplikasi.
tests.en_txt: Cell size: since November 2026 (ADR 0018) 10, 5, 2 and 1 m cells use the same flow as 30 m and only draw the water surface more smoothly (since 13 Nov 2026 without building cut-outs). A 2.2 km box at Kampung Melayu (Ciliwung), 150 mm in 6 h: 30, 10, 5 and 2 m all give 0.4 km², deepest 0.80 m, 2,186 buildings, 9,328 people. Before, the flow was solved again on the small cells and put the water elsewhere (place agreement with 30 m only 6–17 %, deepest 4.5 m); that method is no longer in the app.
metrics: Flooded area > 0.15 m, 30 · 10 · 5 · 2 m (2.2 km box)
Place agreement (CSI) 30 m vs fine flow, 1 km box, trial option

tests.id_txt: Banjir nyata (aturan skor baru, 13 Nov 2026): laporan warga PetaBencana dihitung "kena" bila model ≥ 10 cm di DARATAN dalam ±270 m (air di alur sungai tidak lagi dihitung). Hasil: 50 % (2020), 47 % (2021) dan 41 % (2025) laporan kena, dibanding 43, 28 dan 43 % untuk titik acak di daratan DKI. Model jelas lebih baik dari acak pada 2021, sedikit pada 2020, dan tidak pada 2025. Aturan lama (air sungai ikut dihitung) memberi 72–75 % dan terlalu menyanjung model. Luas banjir DKI 2020: model 83 km², laporan Pemprov 156 km².
tests.en_txt: Observed floods (new scoring rule, 13 Nov 2026): a PetaBencana citizen report counts as hit when the model reaches 0.10 m on LAND within about 270 m (water in river channels no longer counts). Result: 50 % (2020), 47 % (2021) and 41 % (2025) of reports hit, against 43, 28 and 43 % for random points on DKI land. The model is clearly better than random in 2021, slightly in 2020 and not in 2025. The old rule (river water counted) gave 72–75 % and flattered the model. 2020 DKI flooded area: model 83 km², city government 156 km².
metrics: Reports hit within ~270 m (land) vs random, 2020 · 2021 · 2025
Old rule (river water counted), for comparison
Median depth at reports, model / reported
Flooded area > 0.15 m in DKI, 2020: model / reported
90 m, GPM IMERG, pumps off, small-drain sink 0, average soil, subsidence to the event date

tests.id_txt: Kedalaman: di titik laporan, genangan model lebih dangkal dari yang dilaporkan warga. Uji kepekaan dengan hujan satelit dikali 1,5 dan 2: kedalaman 2020 jadi pas pada ×1,5, tetapi luas genangan Jakarta naik ke 200 km² (laporan 156 km²); 2021 baru pas pada ×2, 2025 sudah terlalu dalam pada ×1,5. Tidak ada satu faktor yang cocok, jadi aplikasi tetap memakai hujan apa adanya. (Uji kepekaan ini masih memakai aturan skor lama; arah hasilnya tetap berlaku, angkanya tidak.)
tests.en_txt: Depth: at report points the modelled water is shallower than citizens reported. Sensitivity runs with satellite rain times 1.5 and 2: 2020 depths match at ×1.5, but the flooded area in Jakarta rises to 200 km² (reported 156 km²); 2021 matches only at ×2, 2025 is already too deep at ×1.5. No single factor fits, so the app keeps the rain as observed. (This sensitivity test used the old scoring rule; its direction holds, its numbers do not.)
metrics: Median depth at reports, new pack (2020 · 2021 · 2025)

tests.id_txt: Pompa, tanah basah dan per-RW: menyalakan pompa polder Jakarta Satu (665 m³/detik) menurunkan skor laporan pada 2020 dan 2021 dan memperkecil luas banjir yang sudah terlalu kecil, jadi bawaannya mati (bisa dinyalakan sebagai skenario). Tanah basah (AMC III) menaikkan skor sedikit (2020: 50 → 51 %). Per RW (2.610 RW): kemampuan membedakan RW banjir dan tidak banjir lemah (AUC 0,62; 0,5 = acak).
tests.en_txt: Pumps, wet soil and RW places: switching on the Jakarta Satu polder pumps (665 m³/s) lowers the report score in 2020 and 2021 and shrinks a flooded area that is already too small, so they start off (available as a scenario). Wet soil (AMC III) raises the score a little (2020: 50 → 51 %). Per RW (2,610 RW): the ability to tell flooded from dry RW is weak (AUC 0.62; 0.5 = random).
metrics: DKI flooded area, pumps off / on

tests.id_txt: Saluran mikro Jakarta Selatan (data ukuran DSDA, 8.551 ruas): dinyalakan, model di Jakarta Selatan menjadi jauh lebih kering. Pada banjir 2021 (119 laporan warga di daerah yang dilayani) laporan yang terkena turun dari 50 % ke 28 % (titik acak 27 % → 10 %), dan kedalaman model di titik laporan turun dari 0,11 m ke hampir 0 m, padahal warga melaporkan sekitar 0,9 m. Jadi bawaannya mati, seperti pompa. Penyebab utama: hujan satelit IMERG lebih rendah dari hujan sebenarnya, dan saluran dihitung bekerja penuh (tidak tersumbat, tidak tertahan air sungai). 2020 (21 laporan) dan 2025 (3 laporan) terlalu sedikit untuk disimpulkan.
tests.en_txt: South Jakarta micro drains (DSDA size records, 8,551 sections): switched on, the model in South Jakarta becomes much drier. In the 2021 flood (119 citizen reports in the served area) the share of reports hit fell from 50 % to 28 % (random points 27 % → 10 %), and the model depth at the reports fell from 0.11 m to almost 0 m against about 0.9 m reported. So they start off, like the pumps. Main causes: IMERG satellite rain is lower than the real rain, and the drains are counted at full capacity (no blockage, no backwater from rivers). 2020 (21 reports) and 2025 (3 reports) are too few to conclude.
metrics: Reports hit in the served area, micro off / on (2020 · 2021 · 2025)
Random points in the served area, off / on
Flooded served land (> 0.15 m), off / on
Reports hit, all DKI, off / on
